structuralFinding.globalTrigger: executionResearchEventTypes adds FORMAL_SIGNAL_OBSERVED when notifications.length > 0 at the whole-monitor-run level.
structuralFinding.writeLoop: recordProspectiveExecutionShadow then loops the FORMAL_SIGNAL_OBSERVED event across every result.ok symbol.
structuralFinding.perSymbolEventKey: For each result it filters notifications by symbol; when none match, eventKey falls back to literal SIGNAL.
structuralFinding.consequence: event_type=FORMAL_SIGNAL_OBSERVED alone is not positive evidence that that row's symbol had a Formal signal.

safeAttribution.positive: Require a non-generic event_key containing parseable signalId(s) whose embedded symbol equals the row symbol.
safeAttribution.preferredPositivePriceSource: V8.5 v8_trade_journal_signals for exact positive formal signal occurrence/market_price.

impact: Research-observability semantics only; Formal signals/push/selection are unaffected.
